title: SEDI Capability Building Grants 2026-27
notify: Existing eligible social enterprises delivering direct benefit to people facing entrenched disadvantage, including eligible First Nations social enterprises.
tip: Up to $120,000 for approved specialist capability-building services, capped at the enterprise's annual turnover. Rolling rounds are anticipated through early 2027; the department publishes no single fixed deadline.
action: Confirm an existing legal and trading social enterprise, target beneficiaries, measurable social impact, turnover and capability gap before submitting an expression of interest. Do not use this as formation or general project-delivery funding.
source: Australian Government Department of Social Services

title: Support at Home Thin Markets Round 3
notify: Existing eligible Support at Home providers maintaining rural, remote, specialised or culturally responsive aged-care services.
tip: Applicant amount varies; more than $311 million is the round envelope. Closes 2:00pm AEDT 26 November 2026.
action: Confirm provider eligibility, service thin-market category, Specialisation Verification where required, older-person needs, cultural authority, workforce, service continuity evidence and budget before proceeding.
source: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing

title: Elevate: First Nations Storytelling and Literature Fund
notify: Eligible First Nations writers, poets, editors, illustrators, journalists, arts workers and literature groups with a defined career-development or literature project.
tip: $10,000 fixed grant. Closes 3:00pm AEST 15 September 2026; registration is required at least two business days earlier.
action: This round is closed. Keep a future-round literature evidence pack only for an eligible First Nations individual or group with confirmed identity, ABN or administrator, permissions, work samples and budget.

title: First Nations Arts and Culture Business Innovation Award
notify: Existing 100% First Nations-owned and led small-to-medium arts and cultural businesses or community organisations with demonstrated innovation and cultural integrity.
tip: One $25,000 award. Self-nominations close 3:00pm AEST 15 September 2026; registration is required at least two business days earlier.
action: This award round is closed. For any future round, only an already eligible and established entity with evidence of ownership, leadership, innovation, cultural integrity and registration should proceed.

title: NIAA Community Initiated Proposals
notify: First Nations communities, organisations, businesses or individuals with a community-developed proposal that has no better open funding pathway.
tip: Amount varies. NIAA requires an initial discussion and proposal review before it may invite a full Agency Collaborates application.
action: Confirm the affected community developed and authorises the proposal, document the need and regional alignment, check other open programs first, then let an authorised human decide whether to approach the NIAA regional office.

title: Indigenous Business Australia Business Finance
notify: Eligible Indigenous-owned businesses with a commercially viable plan for working capital, equipment, fit-out or commercial assets and a demonstrated capacity to repay finance.
tip: Business loans range from $10,000 to $5 million. Start-up finance up to $150,000 may include up to 30% as a grant for eligible capital purchases.
action: Confirm Indigenous ownership, legal entity, business plan, forecasts, repayment capacity, security, quotes and legal asset ownership before any finance enquiry. Treat the main amount as debt, not grant income.

title: Screen Australia Narrative Content Development
notify: Eligible Australian narrative creators or production companies with a developed story concept, authentic creative connection and a viable audience pathway.
tip: $10,000-$50,000 per application. Applications are always open.
action: Prepare the story materials, rights chain, creative-team evidence, development plan, audience pathway, budget and any First Nations or community protocols before applying.

title: CRC Round 28 AI Accelerator forecast
notify: National-scale industry, research and community consortia developing commercially relevant artificial intelligence capability.
tip: About $50 million is forecast for at least one AI CRC, but that is a program envelope. Round 28 applicant amounts, dates and final rules are not yet published.
action: Watch for 2027 guidelines. Only build a pathway where an industry-led consortium, research partners, matching contributions, commercialisation case and genuine community role can be evidenced.

title: Queensland Touring Fund Round 3
notify: Queensland artists, groups or organisations with a developed, tour-ready arts or cultural work and a credible regional Queensland audience pathway.
tip: Up to $100,000 for a single tour or touring program up to 12 months, covering up to 50% of costs. Additional access funding up to $10,000 may be available. Closes 2:00pm AEST 12 October 2026.
action: Confirm applicant eligibility, developed work, at least three regional locations outside the home location, presenters or venues, contracts, rights, cultural authority where relevant, budget, co-funding and tour delivery capacity.

title: Queensland Tourism Business Capability Subsidy
notify: Existing eligible Queensland tourism and events businesses seeking approved training or accreditation, not project-delivery or equipment funding.
tip: Up to $2,000. Closes 30 September 2026 or earlier when funds are exhausted; no closing time is published.
action: Confirm an existing eligible business, ATDW registration, ABN, GST, Queensland base, workforce size and an approved training or accreditation course before applying.

title: Queensland Community Housing Energy Upgrades rebate
notify: Registered community housing providers that own and manage existing eligible Queensland community-housing dwellings.
tip: Up to $4,500 excluding GST per eligible dwelling. Applications close 30 October 2026 and installations must finish by 30 June 2027.
action: Confirm provider registration and dwelling ownership, choose eligible upgrades, obtain compliant quotes and secure QRIDA conditional approval before any purchase or installation.
source: Queensland Government Department of Housing and Public Works

title: Active Transport Fund - Tranche 2 2026
notify: State, territory and local government applicants with a complete public-road-associated walking or bicycle pathway construction project.
tip: Up to $5 million per project; a cash co-contribution is required and in-kind support is not accepted. Closes 5:00pm AEST 30 September 2026.
action: Only a government applicant can proceed. Confirm the public-road connection, complete construction scope, land and road authority, design maturity, cost estimate, cash co-contribution, procurement and delivery evidence.

title: On Farm Connectivity Program Round 3
notify: Established eligible primary producers considering approved connectivity or ag-tech equipment through a Round 3 Approved Supplier.
tip: $1,000-$20,000 excluding GST, covering up to 50% of eligible equipment costs. Applications close 5:00pm AEDT 15 October 2026 and the demand-driven pool may exhaust earlier.
action: Confirm primary-producer ANZSIC activity, 12-month ABN, $40,000-$4 million average gross income, approved supplier, eligible equipment, itemised quote and 50% purchaser contribution. Do not purchase before approval.
source: business.gov.au / Australian Government Department of Infrastructure

title: National Songwriting and Recording in Schools Stimulus 2026
notify: Eligible Australian education or music-learning organisations and consortia with at least one educational institution, an ABN and two years of operation.
tip: $5,000-$100,000 in matched funding. Applications close 3:00pm AEDT 13 October 2026; system registration must be completed before 10:00am AEDT 12 October.
action: Confirm an eligible lead institution, student cohort, matched funding, original contemporary-music program, educators, rights, child safety, budget and repeatable pathway before drafting.

title: Transforming Queensland Manufacturing Grants Round 2
notify: Established eligible Queensland manufacturers with a ready advanced-manufacturing investment, matched funding and capacity to deliver jobs and measurable benefits.
tip: Matched grants up to $1.5 million. Applications close 1:00pm AEST 25 November 2026; the $12.5 million figure is the whole Round 2 envelope.
action: Confirm the manufacturing business, eligible activity, project readiness, matched funding, financial capacity, technical case, quotes, jobs, benefits and any security requirement before drafting.

title: Creative Australia AusArt Day 2026
notify: Australian artists, collectives and arts organisations able to run a dedicated 12-hour digital fundraising campaign on 22 October.
tip: Public donations vary; this is not a grant. Registration closes 24 September 2026 and the 2026 micro-grant applications are already closed.
action: Confirm the artist or organisation, authority, campaign purpose, fundraising platform, public story, rights, ICIP protocol compliance where relevant, donor handling and reporting capacity before registering.

title: Creative Australia ACF Boost 2027
notify: Eligible Australian artists, collectives and arts organisations with an active ABN or auspice and one defined cultural project ready for an Australian Cultural Fund campaign.
tip: Dollar-for-dollar matched funding up to $5,000. Applications close 12:00pm AEDT 19 October 2026; successful campaigns run from 1 February to 30 April 2027.
action: Confirm one eligible cultural project, applicant or auspice, ABN, rights, authority, campaign target, donor strategy, balanced budget, delivery capacity and First Nations protocols where relevant before applying.

title: ARENA Launchpad Startup Funding Round 2026
notify: Eligible founders and early-stage clean-energy startups with a real pre-commercial technology, capable team and commercialisation pathway.
tip: $500,000 per grant, with up to a further $500,000 for projects with high capital expenditure. Applications close 4:00pm AEDT 28 October 2026.
action: Confirm the legal startup, technology eligibility, intellectual property, technical evidence, team, budget, co-funding and investor or deployment pathway before drafting.

title: ARENA Launchpad Ecosystem Funding Round 2026
notify: Established clean-energy accelerators, incubators and ecosystem providers capable of running a multi-year commercialisation-support program.
tip: Up to $5 million per ecosystem partner. The round remains open until the $15 million allocation is exhausted.
action: Confirm the legal provider, existing cohort and delivery track record, ARENA alignment, investor and customer pathways, multi-year program, budget, governance and evidence before applying.
